newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech President Havel ill with pneumonia.
newsitem.headline: Czech President Havel ill with pneumonia.

text.p: Czech President Vaclav Havel is suffering from pneumonia and has cancelled a two-day state visit to Ukraine, his office said on Monday.
The president's spokesman, Ladislav Spacek, said in a statement that Havel had also cancelled the rest of his scheduled engagements for the rest of November due to his condition.
"Because of the illness the state visit to Ukraine is being postponed and the rest of (Havel's) working programme for two weeks is cancelled," the statement said.
It said Havel had not been in hospital.

The illness caused the president to forego his tradition of laying anniversary flowers at a monument on Prague's National Avenue (Narodni Trida) where the Havel-led velvet revolution over the Communist government began seven years ago on Sunday.
During the visit to Kiev starting on Tuesday, Havel was to meet Ukraine's president Leonid Kuchma and Prime Minister Pavlo Lazarenko. He was also scheduled to visit the Chernobyl nuclear power plant.
